caption: The drawing depicts a small, pouch-like object suspended by a long red ribbon tied in a bow at the top. The upper portion of the pouch is rendered in shades of pink and red, featuring a textured, woven pattern with hints of small bead-like decorations. The lower portion transitions to a brown color with a denser weave and showcases a decorative design consisting of geometric, star-shaped patterns made up of grey and light blue beads. The bottom edge of the pouch is adorned with a fringe made of multiple strings of grey beads hanging down. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background with a few faint stains, and an artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner alongside some numbers.
title: Beaded Coin Purse
